login.subtitle: Secure remote administration for StreamDing.
login.description: Sign in with Twitch to access the StreamDing instances available to your account.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Remote StreamDing instances available to your Twitch account.
dashboard.empty: No StreamDing instance currently grants you remote access.

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: StreamDing installations you currently have remote access to.
instances.empty: No StreamDing instance currently grants you remote access.
instances.info: Instances are paired from the local StreamDing integration. Moderator access is synchronized by StreamDing and is not managed in this panel.
instances.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? This permanently unpairs the instance and removes its cloud state. This action cannot be undone.

instance.subtitle: Remote controls provided by this StreamDing instance.
instance.unavailable: This instance is no longer available to your account.
instance.noMacros: No remote macros are exposed by this StreamDing.
instance.emptySection: No data is currently available for this section.
instance.previewUnavailable: No Yolobox preview is currently available.
instance.chooseMacros: Choose macros to show on this card.
instance.noScenes: No scenes are available for this OBS connection.
instance.customizeDashboardHint: Choose which sections are visible and set their order for this instance.
instance.dragCardsHint: Drag cards to rearrange them. Remove cards with the × button.
instance.noDashboardCardsHint: Add a card to build this instance dashboard.

pairing.title: Pair StreamDing
pairing.description: A StreamDing is requesting access to your cloud account. Enter this PIN in the local StreamDing panel to finish pairing.
pairing.waiting: Waiting for StreamDing to verify the PIN…

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your personal remote admin preferences.
settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used by the remote admin panel. This setting is stored with your account.
settings.kofiDescription: Configure the Ko-fi webhook for your streamer account. Valid events are forwarded to all currently connected StreamDing instances you own.
settings.kofiNeedsInstance: Ko-fi can only be configured when you own at least one linked StreamDing instance.
settings.kofiWebhookHint: Paste this URL into Ko-fi as the webhook destination for your account.
settings.kofiWebhookUnavailable: Webhook URL is not available yet
settings.kofiCopyError: Could not copy the webhook URL.
settings.kofiTokenHint: Enter the verification token from your Ko-fi webhook settings.
settings.kofiTokenConfiguredHint: A verification token is already configured but is not returned by the cloud. Enter the token again when saving changes.
settings.kofiRelayHint: Optional HTTPS webhook destinations, one URL per line.
settings.kofiRelayLimit: Up to 10 public HTTPS relay URLs.
settings.kofiManageHint: Configure the webhook in your Ko-fi account under Manage Webhooks.
